attribution.classMeaning: The UCI source does not define semantic meanings for class 0 and class 1.

fields.name: banknote_id
fields.zh-CN: 按 UCI 原始文件顺序生成的一基稳定行号。
fields.en: One-based stable row id following the UCI source order.

fields.name: variance
fields.zh-CN: UCI 提供的小波变换图像 variance 特征。
fields.en: UCI variance feature derived from the wavelet-transformed image.

fields.name: skewness
fields.zh-CN: UCI 提供的小波变换图像 skewness 特征。
fields.en: UCI skewness feature derived from the wavelet-transformed image.

fields.name: curtosis
fields.zh-CN: UCI 源文件拼写为 curtosis 的连续特征；本项目保留该拼写。
fields.en: Continuous feature spelled curtosis by the UCI source; this project preserves that spelling.

fields.name: entropy
fields.zh-CN: UCI 提供的小波变换图像 entropy 特征。
fields.en: UCI entropy feature derived from the wavelet-transformed image.

fields.name: class
fields.zh-CN: UCI 提供的 class 0 或 class 1；源页面未定义两类的人类语义。
fields.en: UCI class 0 or class 1; the source page does not define human-readable meanings.

fields.name: split
fields.zh-CN: 固定的 train、validation 或 test 分配；划分后不再重排。
fields.en: Persisted train, validation, or test assignment with no later reshuffling.
